translation: Examining the ancients, the Jingui (Golden Cabinet) gives the causes of summerheat, heatstroke, and convulsion, and Jiegu distinguished heatstroke from heat-stroke by activity and stillness; each has profound principle. I will not summarize them here.

In pediatrics, summerheat-heat disease is often mixed with other diseases. Yet the current method does not go beyond dispersing and digesting, adding a single herb of Xiangru or giving one dose of Liuyi San.
Examining the materia medica, Xiangru is acrid-warm, promotes sweating, and can drain stagnant water.
